channel.title: US Top News and Analysis

item.title: Alphabet falls 10% in premarket, putting it on course for its biggest ever post-earnings drop
item.description: Alphabet reported a larger negative free cash flow than analysts had expected while maintaining its spending gudiance for the year.

item.description: The oil major hiked its share buyback program as global volatility in energy markets saw profits soar.

item.description: While a number of IPOs have been pulled or delayed in 2026, the biotech sector has bucked the trend, with 26 companies debuting in U.S. markets.

item.description: The new chairman made clear he leans toward higher interest rates, but left himself options depending on how the data comes in.

item.title: DoorDash's deal to buy Instacart coming as early as Thursday morning, sources tell CNBC
item.description: Speculation of a deal has swirled since last week, and several outlets reported the acquisition could value Instacart at roughly $17 billion.

item.title: Tencent, Visa deepen payments push in China after regulatory green light

item.title: Hands-on with Apple's first touchscreen laptop: Touch is totally optional

item.title: Billionaire Ambani cries tears of joy as Jio Platforms becomes the second most valued Indian firm
item.description: Ahead of Jio's listing, Mukesh Ambani teared up as his three children shared the journey of building Jio and vowed to create value for investors over the next 50 years.

item.title: French Senate backs ‘Rioters Pay’ bill that could make protesters pay $11,000 fines
item.description: More unrest is expected this weekend, following weeks of violent protests across the country – but the bill has drawn criticism.

item.title: Trump methane policy rollback may have minimal impact on crude prices, EPA says
item.description: The EPA projects Trump’s methane rollback would only lower 2027 U.S. crude prices 11 cents a barrel, while lifting domestic oil output 0.09%.

item.title: Here are five key takeaways from the Fed rate decision and Warsh news conference
item.description: Even though the interest-rate vote went as expected, there were a few surprises out of this week's Federal Open Market Committee meeting.

item.title: Over 41,000 U.S. Homeland Security officials' details apparently exposed after massive data breach
item.description: CNBC was able to access the database on the website, and saw it contained names alleged to be of officials, titles, agencies, and offices in cities and states.

item.title: Chipotle shares rise 7% after CEO says same-store sales growth will continue
